prijs.samen: Together with Online Growth: €350 a month, excl. VAT, plus your ad budget.

items.a: €200 a month, excl. VAT, on top of [Online Growth](Diensten#pakket-1) (€150 a month). There's no setup fee and it's cancellable monthly. You pay your ad budget directly to Google or Meta.

items.q: How much ad budget do I need?
items.a: That depends on your sector, your area and how many enquiries you can handle. We look at it together in the free demo. You choose the budget, and it only changes with your approval.

items.q: Who owns the Google Ads account?
items.a: You do. It's in your name and you pay the budget with your own payment card. We get access through an invitation, without you sharing a password. If you stop, you keep your account and all the history.

items.q: How do I see which enquiry came from an ad?
items.a: When an enquiry or booking comes in through a form or the calendar of our platform, it carries its source: the campaign and the ad. You see it with the customer in your customer overview. It works when the visitor enquires or books on the page the ad leads to. That's why we have your ads land on a page with your form or calendar on it.

items.q: Do you also do Facebook and Instagram?
items.a: Yes. Ad management also works on Meta. You then pay the budget directly to Meta. In the free demo we look at which channel suits your business.

items.q: Do you promise a number of customers?
items.a: No. Nobody can honestly promise that. What we do: show you the real numbers every month, from your own account and your own customer overview, and tell you what we're adjusting.

items.q: Can I get ad management without Online Growth?
items.a: No. It's an add-on on top of [Online Growth](Diensten#pakket-1). That's where your customer overview, your forms and your calendar live, and we need those to measure what each ad brought in.
Only once you've approved the campaign and your account is ready. Google then also reviews every ad itself before it can appear.

items.q: I already have a Google Ads account. Can I switch?
items.a: Yes. You invite us into your existing account, so your history stays. In the free demo we look together at what's already running.

items.q: Does this work for a healthcare practice?
items.a: Sometimes, with restrictions. In Belgium, Google doesn't allow ads for prescription medicines, and audiences based on health are restricted. We check up front what's allowed, and only advertise what's within the rules.

cta.text: Book a free 30-minute demo on Teams. We look at your business and tell you honestly whether ads make sense right now.
